jobs.title: Head of Product Line Management - Business Insurance
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Reporting to the Head of Business Insurance Product Management, the Head of Product Line Management is accountable for line management of countrywide commercial products; responsible for profit & loss (P&L) and segmentation strategy for Commercial Multi-Peril, Umbrella, Commercial Auto, and Workers Compensation. This role oversees market and product pricing strategies for profitable growth initiatives across all commercial lines.

Essential Job Functions

As Head of Product Line Management, you will:

- Establish countrywide product and pricing direction, conduct rate structure and competitor analysis including financial benchmarking, and direct a staff of Line of Business Directors who work collaboratively with State Product Management, Sales, Underwriting, and Service to meet stated product goals and service standards.

- Meet all commercial lines top and bottom-line growth goals countrywide; oversee the team responsible for long and short-range pricing strategies including rate segmentation, third-party data integration, pricing sophistication, performance monitoring, and market intelligence.

- Perform executive level reporting on all lines of business on a monthly basis.

- Drive long-term line of business strategies through deep understanding and analysis of P&L drivers at the portfolio management, LOB, and industry levels. Establish key performance indicators for success, monitor countrywide performance, and regularly report and present results to key stakeholders and senior leadership.

- Partner with other product leaders to develop product lines, establish countrywide pricing targets, and build line of business strategies aligned with desired business outcomes. Work with Actuarial to plan and establish countrywide pricing strategies that create growth opportunities while maintaining necessary profit margins.

- Recruit, develop, train, and supervise a team responsible for financial line management for commercial lines. Act as a people strategist, realigning centers with trained staff, designing capacity models and retention strategies, and developing future leaders and technical talent.

Measures of Success

Within the first 12 months, a successful candidate will have achieved the following:

- Established countrywide commercial product performance baselines across all lines of business; implemented pricing strategies and portfolio management initiatives that demonstrate measurable progress against growth and profitability targets.

- Built and deployed an operational framework for rate segmentation, pricing sophistication, and competitive positioning that enables data-informed decision-making and positions the company competitively in the marketplace.

- Developed a team with clear accountabilities, capability roadmaps, and retention strategies. Identified and developed high-potential leaders for future advancement.

- Provide regular and direct product updates to ensure the product organization challenges conventional thinking and brings measurable value to customers. These interactions inform strategic product decisions, align pricing and portfolio strategies with corporate objectives, and ensure the commercial product function operates at the forefront of market trends and competitive dynamics.

Education Requirements

Candidates should reflect the following professional qualifications and experience:

- Bachelor's degree (preferably in business management, mathematics, management information systems, finance, actuarial science, economics, or other analytics-related field). Master's degree preferred.

- 10 or more years of related experience in P&C insurance or comparable financial management roles.

- Strong product knowledge of Commercial Lines P&C products. Demonstrated P&L management experience and line of business ownership on either a territorial or countrywide basis.

- Technical aptitude and proficiency with Microsoft Office products (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). SaaS and SQL abilities preferred. Technical expertise in insurance products, underwriting rules, and rating.

- Demonstrated ability to lead, inspire, and develop a team. Experience with strategic planning, financial analysis, and cross-functional collaboration.

jobs.title: Product Owner I (USFITAS)
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Takes the lead in several areas of product development by following the principles of Agile to manage the team backlog, anticipate and prioritize needs, oversee development stages, act as a primary liaison and evaluate product progress. Serves as the customer proxy; works collaboratively with business owners and other stakeholders to accomplish these tasks. Utilizes basic understanding of the business vision and requires frequent support and direction from the Product Manager and/or Product Owner II or III.

Essential Job Functions

Applies basic scientific practice within iterations in order to routinely plan, do, check and adjust. Manages team backlog items and prioritizes based on business value. Outlines dependencies and informs stakeholders the necessary sequence of development to ensure optimized performance and outcomes. Holds a significant role in quality control and is the primary team member empowered to accept stories as done. Utilizes basic business knowledge and communication skills to anticipate problems, address them accordingly while working cross functionally in a self-organizing manner to accomplish tasks and effectively manage the backlog. Effectively applies critical thinking to identify flexibility in determining how and when each iteration and product element will be developed. Acts as primary communicator and connection between stakeholders, end users and teams determining if each story meets their shared e xpectations. Ensures collaboration from all stakeholders on decisions and strategy providing clear instructions and deliverables for developers. Takes ownership for each stage of the process and final product to ensure the goal and vision are correctly aligned with the work items on the backlog. Provides ongoing refinement of team backlog, coordinates dependencies and manages the inspection and evaluation of product progress through each iteration. Participates in PO and/or ART sync meetings in addition to the system demo to show critical aspects of the solution Participates in Inspect & Adapt (I & A) workshop to work across teams to define and implement improvement stories to increase program quality. A key member of the Agile team who utilizes perspective to define iteration goals and drives execution and delivery. Partners with the business owner to understand needs, manage scope and add/eliminate user stories. Communicates requirements to Agile Team in a clear and collaborative manner to determine new requirements, negotiate teams and dependencies. Regularly interacts closely with the Product Manager in order to discuss goals and vision of the business/value stream, actively gaining knowledge on the matter. Heavily involved in the Program Increment (PI) planning, story definition and assists team with story estimates and sequencing. Oversees the development of the product to include planning, refinement, review, and execution. Partners with stakeholders to identify and organize steps required for next iteration. Works to gain clarity on queries and participate in the demo of committed items. Participates in ceremonies within the team to coordinate efforts with team to refine the process, identify areas for improvement and support the execution of tasks. Continuously keeps the end-user needs in mind to ensure the solution meets expectations and the development delivers expected outcomes from the accepted stories. Performs other duties as assigned.

Physical Actions

Physical Environment

The following are standard requirements for all positions. When applicable, some positions may have additional requirements essential to a specific job. This position operates in an open office working environment which will include normal and customary distractions, noise, and interruptions. Sits or stands for extended periods of time, up to a full work shift. Occasionally reaches overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Occasionally moves, lifts, carries, and places objects and supplies weighing 0-10 pounds without assistance. Listens to, interprets, and differentiates auditory information (e.g. others speaking) at normal speaking levels with or without correction. Visually verifies and reads information. Visually locates material, resources and other objects. Ability to operate a computer for extended periods of time, up to a full work shift. Physical dexterity sufficient to use hands, arms, and shoulders repetitively to operate keyboard and other office equipment up to a full work shift.

Education Requirements

Bachelor's degree preferred. SAFe Product Owner Certification (obtained within 180 days of hire) required.

Experience Requirements

One year experience in an Agile environment or 2+ years of experience in a project environment.

Special Skill Requirement

Possesses strong product knowledge. Possesses business and functional knowledge in the supported value stream. Demonstrated written communication skills. Ability to effectively write user stories and break down features into user stories. Strong verbal communication and listening skills. Excellent organizational skills. Possesses flexibility to work in a fast paced, dynamic environment. Develops and delivers effective presentations. Excellent collaboration and team building skills.

Additional Qualification

About this role...

-
This position is accountable for profit, loss (P&L) and growth for assigned market or product. The role develops, approves, and communicates product change recommendations cross-functionally.

-
The role focuses on pricing, segmentation, and complex analytics to develop market and product strategies. This includes making strategic recommendations across pricing, underwriting, product design, and eligibility to drive profitable growth and business results

-
This position requires natural curiosity, being comfortable with complex unstructured problem solving and dealing with ambiguity.

-
Provides people leadership through direct management or matrix leadership, including talent development, coaching, and performance accountability

What you'll accomplish...

- Has accountability for profit, loss, and growth outcomes for assigned markets or products, including ownership of results, tradeoffs, and corrective actions.

- Utilize data, tools, dashboards, and reports in support of analyzing and managing the profit and growth of the business.

- Develops and owns short and long term market and product strategies, aligning pricing, underwriting, and product actions to achieve business objectives.

- Expertise of pricing and ratemaking principles and the rating and underwriting of products.

- Demonstrate an expertise in marketplace insights, competitive intelligence, and regulatory issues to inform the management and design of products.

- Understand the pricing and underwriting of competitor products in support of analyzing the performance of the business relative to the market and industry.

- Develop, review, and approve product change recommendations, including rate level adjustments with a focus on matching price to risk.

- Identify and lead the exploration of unstructured problems, such as investigation of variances, mix shifts, and impacts of competitor actions.

- Leads regulatory strategy, Department of Insurance negotiations, and change management for assigned markets; accountable for filing outcomes and approvals.

- Drives leadership alignment by framing tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations; influences decisions through clear articulation of strategy and outcomes.

Education needed...

-
High School Diploma or equivalent High school diploma or equivalent required.

-
Bachelor's degree in business or related fields such as mathematics, physics, engineering, economics, finance, statistics, accounting, or actuarial science preferred.

Experience needed...

-
Minimum 6 years of experience in US property & casualty (P&C) in a pricing or actuarial role; or related experience preferred.

-
Experience navigating negotiations with Departments of Insurance and leading product changes in complex regulatory states.

-
People leadership experience preferred

Note: Candidate qualifications may be reviewed against the requirements for the associated levels of this position's core function. Salary grade will be based on selected candidates' experience and skills.

Special Skill needed...

- Possesses strong product knowledge.

- Understands principles of P&C pricing and underwriting.

- Understands key indicators of product health.

- Understands how to review and assess competitor product positioning and go to market strategies.

- Excellent interpretation of complex statistical data.

- Demonstrated analytical skills.

- Strong presentations skills, able to distill complexity to communicate nuanced concepts for specific audiences.

- Possesses strong technical aptitude.

- Experience in Excel is required.

- Effective interpersonal skills.

- Demonstrated strategic thinking and business acumen.
